title: Pretty Deviled Eggs
text: Pretty Deviled Eggs. My deviled eggs were always delicious but ugly.  Now they look as good as they taste.

product_metadata.title: Wilton Dessert Decorator Plus Cake Decorating Tool and Cake Icing Tool
features: Create stars, flowers, leaves and other designs with 4 decorating tips, a fill tip, and 2 couplers
One handed plunger smoothly pushes icing through the cylinder for easy control and quick decorating
Reusable and reliable alternative to disposable icing piping bags for beginners and professionals
Use to decorate cakes and pastries, fill candies, or top appetizers like deviled eggs
Cylinder, bottom ring, tips and couplers are top-rack dishwasher safe; plunger must be hand washed
description: Dive right into to dessert decorating with this handy cake decorating tool. With the tips included, you can create all kinds of icing designs, fill cupcakes or candies, even use it for deviled eggs. Once you've got the Dessert Decorator Plus, you won't want to wait to get started.
